in_arabic.name: Amlahan
in_arabic.long_meaning: Amlahan هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root 'malaha', which means 'to give' or 'to provide'. This name is commonly given to boys, signifying the act of giving, generosity, and support.
